Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Joab Rogério, the Brazilian powerhouse, demonstrated how to put Tupdogs in their place with a sound strategy. With Sweden's top ranked player, Michael Holmstrom, and Finland's top ranked player, Teemu Sainomaa, it was a tense final to play. Of course, experience is important, and Joab Rogério has 36 TWDA entries in the hall of fame, just one less than Ben Peal. The legendary Ruben Feldman of Switzerland was once again piloting the Tupdogs. So for everyone crying about Tupdogs, they also have weaknesses, you just need to learn them.

Finals seating:
Ruben Feldman (5th Seed) Rockcat Tupdog Combat ->
Aitor Candelas Garcia (3rd Seed) Lasombra V5 Bleed ->
Teemu Sainomaa (Topseed) Saulot Anesthetic Touch Block ->
Michael Holmstrom (2nd Seed) Diversion Gun Block ->
Joab Rogério (4th Seed) Baron Animalism combat ->

Final Game: (Joab Rogerio report)
First and foremost, I'd like to thank my friends Igor and Martin for inviting me to participate in the event held last weekend.
It was a fun tournament; it's always good to play with people from different regions. I wish it was easier to play in person, but since that's not possible, we play on Lackey.
When we began the game, I didn't know exactly what to expect from my predator, but I had already played with my prey in round one and had seen more or less what to expect from his deck.
I realized right after the first rush from the Tupdog that I wouldn't be able to play if the game continued like this.
So I agreed with Ruben not to be aggressive toward him, and he would not rush me; this was ideal for me because my predator could not harm me either.
I let the Tupdog play loose and waited for the moment when he became fragile so that I could release my Tension in the Ranks and deliver my final attack.
By this time, I already had 5 or 6 vampires to play aggressively, and I managed to make my VP and win the way I had planned. With the game running out of time, my deck didn't have conditions at that table to kill all the participants at the table, so I played the way I knew I could win.

you can rewatch the final here:
www.twitch.tv/bleeddetres
